title: Enemy Positions Retained Across Level Retry
explanation: At frame 316, player clicked retry. RetryButton.gd:L12-L21 cached 12 enemy positions into BugFlags.retained_enemy_transforms and Enemy.gd:L19-L21 restored them at reload instead of resetting to initial positions, causing an immediate spawn-kill death loop at frame 349.
repro_hint: Allow enemies to advance toward spawn, die, and press Retry; enemies remain at advanced positions.
